# Binita Patel

> Senior SEO Analyst · CRO Specialist · Frontend Developer

## About

Binita Patel is a Senior SEO Analyst at Kinesso, specializing in technical SEO, Core Web Vitals optimization, and data-driven organic growth strategies for enterprise clients. Previously, she worked as a Personalization Specialist at Bounteous, where she ran A/B tests, conducted technical SEO audits, and delivered quarterly strategy reviews.

She is also a co-owner of a Quesada Burritos & Tacos franchise in Lindsay, Ontario, where she manages operations, staffing, and local SEO.

## Skills

- Technical SEO & Site Architecture
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & A/B Testing
- Core Web Vitals & Page Performance
- WordPress & Shopify Development
- Data Analysis & Reporting
- Local SEO & Google Business Profile

## Experience
